text: {"label":"Telehealth Delivery of Behavior-Analytic Services","definition":"Delivering behavior-analytic assessment, treatment, and caregiver or professional training remotely via telehealth, including functional analyses, function-based treatment, coaching, technology requirements, acceptability, and barriers to remote service engagement.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Defined by remote, technology-mediated delivery, unlike general clinical practice and decision-making, communication supports for people with developmental disabilities, or caregiver training conducted in person."}
